name: isproject-framework
description: Asset build for isproject/framework. Only needed to change the design system — resources/dist is committed, so the package runs without npm.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js resources/dist/bootstrap.bundle.min.js && cp node_modules/tom-select/dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js resources/dist/tom-select.min.js && cp node_modules/tom-select/LICENSE resources/dist/tom-select.LICENSE.txt && cp resources/js/isproject.js resources/dist/isproject.js
